radiusSource: Radius 0.457 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Lee et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of GJ 367 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260618355L/abstract): 317,935 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
